item.title: Dean B. Williamson
item.description: Dean B. Williamson passed away peacefully at the Cottages of Weiser on Jan. 30, 2026, surrounded by loved ones. A graveside burial and service will be held March 25, 2026. Dean was born in Logan, Utah on May 20, 1941, to Harvey L. and Sara (Baugh) Williamson. His family moved to New Plymouth, Idaho in 1948 when Harv, and Dean’s older brother, Jay, started Williamson Roofing Company. item.title: Linda Jean Ellwood
item.description: Linda Jean Ellwood was a daughter, a sister, a mother, and most importantly, a grandma, or how she liked to be called, Gram. She was born on July 10, 1964, in Ontario, Ore. She graduated from Weiser High School in 1984 and resided in Weiser, Idaho, for 60 years. In 1997, she had her only child, Joseph Ellwood. item.title: Roland Gerson
item.description: After a strong, brave battle with cancer, Roland Gerson peacefully passed away at home, surrounded by loved ones on the afternoon of Feb. 6, 2026. Roland was an amazing artist. From being a talented custom goldsmith, musician, horseman, and blacksmith, he was extremely creative. Roland also took great pride in being a United States Veteran. item.title: Pesticide applicator seminar to be held Feb. 19
item.description: The Lower Weiser River Cooperative Weed Management Area and Washington County Weed will host a pesticide applicator seminar on Thursday, Feb. 19 at 6 p.m. There is no charge for this class. The seminar will be held in the Exhibit Hall at the fairgrounds, Cambridge. RSVP to the Weed Department at 208-414-1950. Date: Thursday, February 19, 2026 - 6:00pm
